build_base_attention_module: build a BaseAttention module with GlobalConfigs, GraphNeuralNetworksConfigs, and RegularizationConfigs for multi-head attention
create_qkv_projection: create Q, K, V projections by reshaping tensors into multi-head format with linear layers
run_scaled_dot_product_attention: run scaled dot-product attention on projected Q, K, V tensors with an attention mask and dropout
refactor_qkv_projection: refactor the qkv_projection method to support a different tensor permutation or head dimension layout
review_base_attention_init: review the BaseAttention __init__ to verify linear projection layers and attention hyperparameters are configured correctly
